title: So off it won’t work.
text: So off it won’t work.. I like the idea of a mini fridge riser, if it were to work and assemble properly. This one will not. One of the parts is drilled a bit off so the bolt will not go in all the way. If it weren’t supposed to support a mini fridge plus content it would be fine. But it definitely will not support a minimum of 70 lbs. without the bolt completely going in. It will have to  be returned. A disappointment for certain.
